name: BlahDNS Browser Extension 0.2.1 preview
body:
BlahDNS Browser Extension 0.2.1 fixes cosmetic CSS comment poisoning and makes native privacy/proxy status queries read-only.

- Reject CSS comment delimiters in cosmetic selectors. A malformed rule such as ##.x/* is reported instead of commenting out later valid hide rules.
- getState now uses readPrivacy/readProxy and does not set/clear native settings or register proxy listeners after initialization. Actual mismatches and per-section read errors stay visible. Background initialization, explicit saves and rollback retain their apply paths.
- Chromium proxy status verifies actual PAC contents and control priority. Proxy routing and no-direct-fallback behavior are unchanged.

Verified: 46 unit tests, 232 expectations, and 19 integration checks each in Chrome, Brave and Firefox. Real browser regressions verify valid cosmetic hiding after a rejected bad rule; Chrome/Brave native write spies confirm getState performs no writes. Existing WebRTC/RFP, scoped HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy, WebSocket, import/export, themes and default-list updates still pass. Repeat builds produce identical ZIP/XPI hashes.

Downloads: Chromium ZIP, Firefox ZIP, unsigned Firefox XPI and SHA256SUMS. Firefox ZIP and XPI are byte-identical. Use Load unpacked for the extracted Chromium ZIP; use Firefox about:debugging → Load Temporary Add-on with the intact XPI or manifest.json from the extracted Firefox ZIP. Temporary Firefox installs end at restart. Ordinary permanent Firefox installation requires Mozilla signing.

No dependency, permission, telemetry, fingerprint spoofing or store submission is added. DoH setup remains manual; protocol behavior and CAPTCHA outcomes are not guaranteed. Previous release tags and assets are preserved. Detailed evidence is in docs/evals/0.2.1/.
